question: Does a theme-valid public-validation bottleneck reduce Demis's outcome advantage while preserving full Capability, and does Elon's realized-infrastructure Mandate replicate on fresh common seeds?

factionTruth.imperialProtectedStrength: Compute access, Research reliability, and Capability remain unchanged. The candidate may reduce only immediate public Mandate when a rescued run crosses a Capability threshold.
factionTruth.verticalProtectedStrength: Infrastructure velocity and the existing Facility discount remain unchanged. The candidate scores only an actual completed discount.
factionTruth.eligibility: A statistically effective candidate is rejected if it violates either protected strength or makes one Core Action compulsory.

selectionRule.imperialCandidate: Prefer the one-Mandate public-validation penalty only if it materially reduces Demis at four players, remains directionally corrective at three, does not push Demis below parity at five, preserves all banked Capability, and does not materially collapse Research selection.
selectionRule.verticalCandidate: Confirm one Mandate when Industrial Velocity actually reduces Runway paid for a completed Facility only if the fresh-seed paired win-share, score, and rank deltas improve Elon at four players, remain bounded at three and five, and Build selection does not materially increase.
selectionRule.pairedAuthority: Compare each candidate only with canonical under common seeds. Positive paired rankDelta means the candidate improves placement. Do not combine the candidates in this experiment.
selectionRule.integrity: Any integrity violation, policy fallback, unsupported-count gap, missing paired rank diagnostic, or Capability loss in the public-validation arm rejects the affected arm.
selectionRule.promotion: No physical text changes without a tracked receipt, complete surface audit, new immutable candidate, and explicit user approval.
